question: At which place in India does the river Yamuna meet the river Ganges?
solution: The correct answer is __**Prayagraj**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The Yamuna river meets the Ganges river at a place called "Triveni Sangam" in Allahabad (now officially known as Prayagraj. • A city located in the northern Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. • This is considered a holy site for Hindus and attracts a large number of pilgrims every year.
